name: structural-model
title: Structural model of M. genitalium — reproducing Maritan 2022 with viva-parsimony
lead:
This is the structural companion to the seven figure-studies of the `mgen`
investigation. Where those reproduce the Karr 2012 whole-cell model's dynamics,
this one reproduces its *structure*: it takes the same molecular inventory and,
following Maritan, Autin, Karr, Covert, Olson & Goodsell (J. Mol. Biol. 2022),
builds a 3D packed cell — but with the reusable viva-parsimony engine rather
than CellPACK. It is the M. genitalium analog of the 3d-ecoli repo (v2ecoli →
pbg_parsimony); here it is viva_mgen → pbg_parsimony.

at_a_glance.role: Faithful Maritan/WC-MG baseline — the reference 3D cell, packed with parsimony.
Variant driven by the viva_mgen reproduction's simulated proteome — same roster, less crowded (occupancy ~0.04 vs 0.144).

glossary.definition: Octree molecular packers that place structures at true abundance inside a cell envelope. Maritan used CellPACK; this work uses parsimony (pbg_parsimony).
Maritan 2022 supplementary tables: S1 = protein ingredient roster (structures, compartments); S2 = gene table (coordinates, UniProt, essentiality).
One molecular species placed by the packer, with a structure (or sphere proxy), a copy number, and a compartment.

biological_story:
A Mycoplasma genitalium cell is among the smallest self-replicating cells
known — a ~0.3 µm envelope enclosing a single circular chromosome (~580 kbp,
525 genes) and a few tens of thousands of protein molecules. Maritan et al.
showed that the whole-cell model's molecular bookkeeping — which proteins,
how many, where — is complete enough to assemble into a physically plausible
3D cell: a crowded cytoplasm, a supercoiled nucleoid threaded by RNA
polymerases and ribosomes, and a membrane studded with its transporters.

This investigation rebuilds that cell with viva-parsimony. Each protein in the
Maritan roster is resolved to a structure (an experimental PDB assembly where
the paper curated one, otherwise an AlphaFold model by its UniProt accession),
given a copy number, and dropped into a capsule by the parsimony octree packer
until the cell is full. The chromosome is laid down as a supercoiled rod with
each gene at its real genomic coordinate, so transcribing RNA polymerases sit
where the biology puts them. The result is a structural readout of the same
cell the seven figure-studies simulate dynamically — a bridge from the model's
numbers to a picture of the cell they describe.
question:
Can the Maritan et al. 2022 3D whole-cell structural model of Mycoplasma
genitalium be reproduced with viva-parsimony (the parsimony cellPACK-style
engine) in place of CellPACK — packing the same molecular inventory at true
abundance into a single-membrane cell — and does the viva_mgen whole-cell-model
reproduction's own simulated proteome yield a comparable 3D cell?
hypothesis:
The Maritan ingredient roster (supplementary table S1, ~683 protein species)
plus genome geometry (S2), resolved to PDB/AlphaFold structures and packed with
the parsimony octree engine into a ~0.3 µm capsule, recovers Maritan's headline
mesoscale properties — hundreds of species placed at true abundance, a single
supercoiled nucleoid, membrane proteins seated in the bilayer, and cytoplasmic
crowding in the reported range. Swapping the copy numbers for a viva_mgen
simulated run yields a structurally comparable cell, differing only where the
reproduction's predicted proteome diverges from the published WC-MG counts.

executive.what_is_this:
A structural investigation that reproduces the first 3D whole-cell model of
M. genitalium (Maritan 2022) using viva-parsimony. The Maritan supplement
(S1 proteins, S2 genes) supplies the ingredient roster, per-species
structures (curated PDB where available, else AlphaFold by UniProt), and the
circular genome; the pbg_parsimony octree engine packs them at true abundance
into a single-membrane capsule with one supercoiled nucleoid. Two studies
contrast the published WC-MG abundances (faithful baseline) against the
viva_mgen reproduction's simulated proteome.
executive.verdict:
BOTH studies run and PASS. s01-maritan-baseline packs a genuine, faithful 3D
M. genitalium cell with the real parsimony binary: Maritan's 144.47 nm sphere,
30,355 molecules, 506 species (all structure-resolved), 75 membrane proteins,
one supercoiled chromosome, and a protein volume occupancy of 0.144 — exactly
Maritan Table 1's reported figure. s02-reproduction-driven packs the same cell
from the viva_mgen reproduction's own SIMULATED proteome: the species roster
is comparable (605/632 baseline species present), but the cell is less crowded
(occupancy ~0.04) — the reproduction's absolute per-gene abundances run below
the WC-MG published counts Maritan used. The Maritan structural model is
faithfully reproduced with viva-parsimony (not CellPACK); the reproduction's
proteome is structurally self-consistent but abundance-scaled differently.
executive.verdict_detail:
Done: the viva_mgen.structural bridge (parse S1/S2 → roster; PDB/AlphaFold
resolution; WC-MG + sim copy-number providers; build_mgen_pack over the real
parsimony engine; the mgen_structural composite + MgenStructuralStep); the
faithful Maritan-sphere geometry (Table 1, Frame 149 s) with occupancy
calibrated to the reported 0.144; a real baseline pack AND a real
reproduction-driven pack; the pbg_parsimony 3D viewer for each. Remaining
(optional): a full-cell-cycle / population-averaged sim for s02 (the current
variant is an early-cell-cycle proteome), and curated structure upgrades for
the 165 unstructured complexes.

scientific_argument.main_claim:
A faithful 3D whole-cell structural model of M. genitalium can be rebuilt
from the Maritan 2022 molecular inventory with the reusable viva-parsimony
engine, and the same pipeline can be driven by the viva_mgen reproduction's
own simulated abundances.
evidence_for: Real parsimony pack of the Maritan roster: hundreds of species placed at true abundance, one supercoiled nucleoid, RNAP sites seeded from the S2 genome (s01).
Exact cross-namespace joins (karr gene_id ↔ S2 protein_monomer ↔ S1 ProtID): 479/482 monomers get counts, 0 unmatched.
518/683 species resolve to a real structure (curated PDB or AlphaFold by UniProt).
evidence_against: Copy numbers are an expression-derived proxy for WC-MG abundances (S1 carries no copy-number column); the true WholeCellKB counts are not in-repo.
Cell shape is capsule-simplified and currently near-spherical; the terminal organelle is omitted (as Maritan did).
key_figures: s01 packed cell (3D viewer): the faithful Maritan-baseline M. genitalium cell.
caveats: Packer is parsimony (cellPACK-style), not Maritan's CellPACK.
165/683 species (mostly complexes with no single UniProt) have no structure and are placed as MW-sphere proxies or skipped.
Crowding / volume-occupancy acceptance bands are not yet calibrated to Maritan's reported values.

studies.name: s01-maritan-baseline
studies.title: s01 — Maritan baseline: the faithful 3D M. genitalium cell (parsimony)
studies.question:
Packing the Maritan 2022 ingredient roster (S1) + genome (S2) at the published
WC-MG copy numbers with the parsimony engine, do we recover a faithful 3D
M. genitalium cell — hundreds of species placed at true abundance, a single
supercoiled nucleoid with RNAP sites at real genomic loci, and membrane
proteins in the bilayer?
studies.claim:
A faithful 3D M. genitalium cell (Maritan's 144.47 nm sphere) packs from the
Maritan roster with parsimony: 30,355 molecules, 506 species, 75 membrane
proteins, one supercoiled chromosome, and a protein volume occupancy of 0.144
— exactly Maritan Table 1's reported figure. All acceptance checks PASS.

studies.name: s02-reproduction-driven
studies.title: s02 — Reproduction-driven: the 3D cell from viva_mgen's simulated proteome
studies.question:
Driving the SAME Maritan roster + structures with abundances from a viva_mgen
simulated run (rather than the published WC-MG counts), does the reproduction's
own proteome yield a structurally comparable 3D cell — and where does it diverge?
studies.claim:
The reproduction's simulated proteome packs the SAME cell — 605/632 baseline
species present at comparable roster — but LESS crowded: protein occupancy
~0.04 vs the Maritan-faithful 0.144. The species inventory is structurally
self-consistent; the divergence is one of absolute abundance scale (the
reproduction's simulated per-gene counts are lower than the WC-MG published
numbers Maritan used), not of which molecules are present.
